name: Lighthouse Starting Area Guide
label: Lighthouse
description: The starting coastline: collect Clam, separate the early crab entries, learn the default no-bait pool and finish the missing beer quest for the boat key.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the opening island near the lighthouse

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Pick up Clam around the opening area; it is a ground creature, not a rod catch.
Use the Crab Fishing Rod's default pool for Brown Crab and Shrimp.
Buy Hot Dog for Rock Crab and Lobster.
Use the returned Empty Beer Can to summon Spider Crab, then finish the hand-in for the boat key.

sections.heading: Creatures to find
paragraphs: Clam, Brown Crab, Blue Crab, Rock Crab, Shrimp, Lobster and Spider Crab make up the current Lighthouse route list.

name: Forest Island Guide
label: Forest Island
description: The green Radar marker northwest of the Lighthouse, with the default Fishing Rod pool, nine Beginner Lure targets and the Leech Bait story chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of a wooded tropical island

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Search the ground and bring three leeches to the lady by the lake.
Use the Leech Bait she returns to summon Giant Piranha.
Clear its smaller piranhas first, then defeat the boss.
Return the named boss trophy to receive Desert Island coordinates.

sections.heading: Fishing setup
paragraphs: Mackerel, Gar and Pike are in the default Fishing Rod pool. Beginner Lure adds Cod, Pike, Piranha, Triggerfish, Goby, Salmon, Goldfish, Perch and a low-weight Sunfish result.

sections.heading: Optional completion
paragraphs: The $40 Beginner Boss Lure has an even Sunfish and The Old Pike pool. Giant Piranha is the story encounter that advances the island route.

name: Desert Island Guide
label: Desert Island
description: The yellow Radar marker and Standard Lure tier, where Needlefish opens the Carrot route, Coconut catches Bing Bong and Blue Shark unlocks the grill.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the giant Pufferfish battle
sourceLabel: Official boss screenshot + game bait data

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Catch a Needlefish with the Standard Lure and give it to the tourist under the tree.
Use the Carrot reward to summon the Pufferfish.
Move after short damage windows rather than standing in its charge path.
Return the Pufferfish fin to unlock the red Rocks Island marker.

sections.heading: Fishing and special bait
paragraphs: The Standard Lure table includes Bowlfish and a low-weight Blue Shark result; Salmon belongs to Beginner Lure instead. Coconut costs $350 on this island and has a dedicated Bing Bong pool.

sections.heading: Grill route
paragraphs: The Standard Boss Lure costs $280 and gives Blue Shark a dedicated pool. Bring the defeated shark to the Grillmaster to start the grill; cooking can increase item value up to about 1.5× before burning destroys the value.

name: Rocks Island Guide
label: Rocks Island
description: The red Radar marker and Professional Lure tier, with a twelve-target weighted pool plus the Tuna-to-Albatross story encounter.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot showing a late-game gold weapon and open island water

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Buy the Professional Boss Lure for $1,200 and summon Tuna.
Keep the defeated Tuna instead of selling it.
Place it on the ground to draw in the Albatross.
Return the Albatross head to the shop NPC to unlock the pink Volcano marker.

sections.heading: Professional Lure pool
paragraphs: Sengarat, Red Snapper, Tigerfish, Parrotfish, Bass, Halibut, Flying Fish, Eel, Voxelfish, Dripper, Tuna and Seahorse make up this catch pool. Flounder is not in the pool, so its previous Professional Lure pairing remains unconfirmed.

name: Volcano Island Guide
label: Volcano Island
description: The final pink radar marker: Scientific Lure farming, the optional Goblin Shark and the Bowhead-to-mutated-whale ending chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of late-game equipment on a tropical island

sections.heading: Story route
bullets: Use the Fish Bucket or Whale Bait for the Bowhead Whale step.
Keep the defeated Bowhead Whale for the mutated final encounter.
Finish the Mutated Bowhead Whale to complete the story.
The Handyman achievement requires a separate fists-only final-boss clear.

sections.heading: Collection and money
paragraphs: Scientific Lure costs $500 and reaches the five regular deep-sea species. The optional Scientific Boss Lure costs $5,800 and summons Goblin Shark, a commonly missed Collector target.
